data.summary_en: DiscoveryRSI improves learning valuable hypotheses from the research process via multi-agent evolutionary search: building a hypothesis tree, compiling research plans into executable Harbor tasks, and recursive learning. DiscoveryRSI-27B's hypotheses match post-cutoff published research at 6.3%, above GPT-6 Luna's 2.5% and Claude Opus 5's 2.3%.
